show.description: A legendary sniper who vanished after a tragic mission lives in hiding as a cleaner, until his deadly skills are forced back into action to protect a brave widow, her child, and the nation from a dangerous terror plot.
show.description_secondary: An emotional action thriller where a forgotten sniper fights his past to protect innocent lives and save the nation.
